Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A: The issue-to-PR pipeline workflows: clarify, plan or implement (`.github/workflows/ai-clarify.yml` and related)
B: The review/autofix workflow (`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_autofix_step_*.sh` helpers)
C: The orchestrator: the poller, dispatch, judge and integration-sync
D: Documentation (README, `docs/how-it-works.md`, agents.d fragments)
E: Something else. Please name the file, workflow or feature in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A: Fix a specific bug or failure. Please link the failing run, log or PR in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B: Reduce cost or token use, or GitHub API calls
C: Improve speed or reliability, such as fewer retries or stalls
D: Make it clearer: docs, log messages or prompts
E: Add a new feature or behaviour. Please describe it in your `/answer`
Q3: How should we judge that the change worked?
Choices:
A: A specific test, CI check or workflow run passes. Please name it in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B: A measurable metric improves, such as run time, token count or failure rate. Please state the baseline and target
C: Review of the PR is enough; no objective criterion is needed
